review_scope: Selected eclipse interpretation in hash-verified cached QLP SAP, with bounded follow-up where decisive.
evidence: S54 raw SAP declines from about 1.6 times its sector median toward zero on both spacecraft observing orbits, with ripples through the flagged windows. S55 repeats a rising ramp followed by a sharp reset. S14/S41/S81 do not show matching clean losses. These are large extraction or detector baseline pathologies, not normalizable isolated eclipse profiles.
interpretation: Positive orbit-repeating pathological flux behavior refutes the selected eclipse windows.
limitations: No physically meaningful depth or eclipse epoch can be extracted from these segments; this does not exclude a different binary signal.
catalogue_status: UNKNOWN; VSX, ASAS-SN, Kostov table 3/4 unavailable
